hints.tr: Satırı önce temizle: `line = line.strip()`. Sonra boşsa atla: `if not line: continue`. `continue` döngünün geri kalanını atlayıp bir sonraki satıra geçiyor.
hints.en: Clean the line first: `line = line.strip()`. Then skip it if it is empty: `if not line: continue`. `continue` skips the rest of the loop body and moves to the next line.

hints.tr: `line.split(",")` iki parça veriyor ve ikisini birden alabiliyorsun: `name, value = line.split(",")`. `value` hâlâ metin, `int(value)` ile çevir.
hints.en: `line.split(",")` gives two pieces and you can take both at once: `name, value = line.split(",")`. `value` is still text, so convert it with `int(value)`.

hints.tr: En yükseği bulmak için iki değişken tut: şu ana kadarki en iyi not ve o notun sahibi. Sözlükte dolaşıp daha büyüğünü görünce ikisini de güncelle.
hints.en: To find the highest, keep two variables: the best grade so far and whose it is. Loop through the dictionary and update both whenever you see a bigger one.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
scores = {}

with open("scores.txt", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    for line in file:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        name, value = line.split(",")
        scores[name] = int(value)


average = sum(scores.values()) // len(scores)

top = ""
best = 0
for name in scores:
    if scores[name] > best:
        best = scores[name]
        top = name


print(scores)
print(average)
print(top)
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
scores = {}

with open("scores.txt", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    for line in file:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        name, value = line.split(",")
        scores[name] = int(value)


average = sum(scores.values()) // len(scores)

top = ""
best = 0
for name in scores:
    if scores[name] > best:
        best = scores[name]
        top = name


print(scores)
print(average)
print(top)
```
